chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Jumhūr, from ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mukhtār, who said:
I said to Abū ‘Abdillāh (عليه السلام): “May I be made your ransom.”
“And on the Day of qiyamah you will see those who lied against Allah.”
He (عليه السلام) said: “Everyone who claims that he is an Imam while he is not an Imam.”
I said: “Even if he were a Fāṭimī and an ‘Alawī?”
He (عليه السلام) said: “Even if he were a Fāṭimī and an ‘Alawī.”

key_terms.إِمَامٌ: the divinely designated Imam with rightful religious authority
key_terms.زَعَمَ: claimed or alleged without valid proof
key_terms.فَاطِمِيًّا: a descendant of Sayyidah Fāṭimah (عليها السلام)
key_terms.كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ: falsely attributed to Allah what He did not authorize
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection when truth and falsehood are fully exposed

ai.seo_question: Does being a descendant of Fāṭimah and ‘Alī make someone automatically a rightful Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the Quranic condemnation of lying against Allah includes anyone who falsely claims the station of Imamate without divine right. It emphasizes that noble lineage alone, even descent through Sayyidah Fāṭimah and Imam ‘Alī (عليهما السلام), does not validate a false claim to religious authority.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Al Husayn Bin Al Mukhtar who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>!
[39:60] And on the Day of Judgement you shall see those who lied against Allah’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Everyone who claims that he is an Imam but he isn’t an Imam’.
I said, ‘And even if he was a Fatimiide (from the children of Syeda Fatima<sup>asws</sup>)?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And even if he was a Fatimiide (from the children of Syeda Fatima<sup>asws</sup>), Alawiite (from the children of Ali<sup>asws</sup>)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from mmd ibn Jumhur from ‘Abdallah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar who has said the following.

“I said to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, what is the meaning of the words of Allah, ‘On the Day of Judgment you will see the faces of those who had invented falsehood against God blackened. . .”? [39:60].
He said, “Itrefers to whoever would claim to be the Imam and, in fact, is not the Imam.”
I then asked, “Even if he would a descendant of Fatima and Ali (a.s.)?”
He said, “Yes, even if he would a descendant of Fatima and Ali (a.s.).”
